fields.description: Timez is a residential development in Dubai Silicon Oasis with studios and one- to three-bedroom apartments. Its convertible layouts and selected private-pool configurations vary substantially; the selected floor plan matters more than a single project-wide size range.

overview: The developer lists 1,000 apartments. Its internal 30 September 2026 report gives 27% progress, foundation concreting completed, second-floor concrete casting completed and third-floor preparation underway. This is a dated report, not an independent site inspection.
research.locationNote: Dubai Silicon Oasis. The developer labels a nearby metro station as suggested; it is not presented here as an operating station.
research.priceNote: Danube’s headline is AED 871,000; Property Finder retains an AED 800,000 launch reference. These are different snapshots, not confirmation of currently available entry stock.
research.paymentNote: The current developer headline reads 30/70 but supplies no project-specific milestones. Property Finder lists 70% during construction and 30% on handover. Confirm the selected contract; neither split is silently converted into the other.
research.handoverNote: The developer targets Q2 2028, while Property Finder states July 2028. The conflict remains unresolved; neither forecast confirms handover.

unresolved: Plan totals include outdoor areas. Component-range endpoints can refer to different units and do not always add to displayed total endpoints. Printed figures are retained.
Brochure imagery suggests pools broadly, but the measured plans identify particular pool layouts. Convertible labels do not alter the legal bedroom count automatically.
Current stock, detailed primary instalments, contractual delivery, parking, approved service charges and furniture specifications require confirmation. Images remain illustrative.
